tools.name: wrs_business_facts
tools.description: Name, legal name, address, telephone, fax, service area, client portal, hours note and the list of services for Western Reporting Services, an independent Las Vegas court reporting firm (since 1990).

tools.name: wrs_list_services
tools.description: Every service Western Reporting Services offers (deposition reporting, realtime, transcripts, legal videography, interpreters, nationwide referral, conference rooms, remote depositions) with a summary and the page URL.

tools.name: wrs_list_guides
tools.description: Index of the firm's long-form guides on depositions and Nevada court reporting practice: slug, title, description, published and updated dates, and whether the guide's Nevada legal statements are sourced from the FACTS rules report. Witness guides also exist in Spanish (es), Tagalog (tl), Simplified

tools.name: wrs_search
tools.description: Keyword search across guide titles, section headings, body text and glossary terms. Returns the best matches with the page URL and a short snippet. Use wrs_get_guide for the full text of a match.

tools.name: wrs_get_guide
tools.description: One guide in full as Markdown (sections, checklist, common questions) with its URL, dates and legal-source note. Pass the slug from wrs_list_guides or wrs_search.

tools.name: wrs_glossary_term
tools.description: Plain-English definition of a court reporting or deposition term (appearance fee, errata sheet, read and sign, realtime, rough draft, stenotype, 30(b)(6) and so on). Matches the term, an alias, or a close contains-match.
